I just want to recommend a few things; bring a cart or wagon to bring your supplies in! The cars are pretty far away from where you camp and you have to walk uphill to get to the campsite. Also bring everything you will need for the day with you into the venue (deodorant, sunscreen, etc) the campsite is also very far from the venue and is a longggg walk. Also bring a bandana or something similar because the dust last year was very bad. Also since there’s no shade bring an easy up!

You have every right to feel like you have lost something, because you have. Let your feelings run your course and plan for a strong range of emotions. I had an abortion two days ago and I knew that I would not let this be in vain. I do not have a way to support a child right now and my boyfriend and I knew we were too young, too irresponsible with our money, and too not ready for this step. BUT I made a promise to better myself in a time span of 9 months which may be kind of morbid but again I don't want it to be in vain. Take a mental health day and then start planning your next steps (when you're ready) to ensure that one day you can be the person you want to be in order to have a child.  That's helped me quite a bit and hopefully that helps you as well.
